name: Abdullah Abou-Auf
career_history: Associate Director at Mace Group, 3/2026 to present; Senior Cost Manager at Mace Group, 8/2021 to 3/2026; Senior Cost Manager at Cumming, 12/2020 to 7/2021; Cost Manager at Cumming, 8/2017 to 12/2020; Assistant Project Manager at AECOM, 4/2016 to 8/2017; Structural Designer at FDR Engineers PLLC, 10/2015 to 4/2016; Student Senator at The American University in Cairo, 12/2014 to 5/2015; Teaching Assistant at The American University in Cairo, 9/2014 to 5/2015
education: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.), Construction Engineering with concentrations in Construction Management, The American University in Cairo, 2010 to 2015
biography: Abdullah has been at Mace for just over 5 years. Currently exploring the next phase of his career for growth and family. Prefers to transition to an owner-side role rather than consultancy. Has experience in life science and manufacturing technology sectors. Worked on data center and office consolidation for Siemens. Worked on 3 colocation data center projects (2MW each) with Center Square, from pre-construction to construction phase. Currently embedded in a $1 billion pharma project in the pre-construction phase. Has a charter ship certification, which pushes for well-rounded skills. Finds Mace's pre-construction team weak, especially in MEP and detailed estimating, leading to reliance on external consultants. Previously worked at Cumming, which had a robust pre-construction team and decent MEP support.

assessment.note: Ward Search's own judgement, not a researched fact.
